properties.description: The class behind hxm_program F-19, taken on Anthony's word after three wrong counts were put to him. F-19 fixed one field (`Requirement.concern`) and recorded `contained_symptom`, standing in for "a check that every declared enum reachable through a request field publishes its values, so the next one cannot ship unwired". This epoch is that check, plus the 31 fields it found.
properties.name: The enum-publishing class is closed: 31 fields wired and a guard that keeps the count at zero
